title.narrative: Förstärkning av SRHR vid folkhälsomyndigheter i Afrika
Strengthening SRHR at African public health institutions

description.narrative: A program to strengthen institutional public health capacity on sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR) in Southern Africa. The Public Health Agency of Sweden leads the implementation of the program, with the strategic advice and engagement from Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC). The programme aims to strengthen institutional frameworks, technical capacities, human resources and communication by cooperation with and between ministries of health, national agencies, academia, and civil society organizations in Sub-Saharan Africa and Sweden.

A capacity development program to strengthen sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR) at national public health institutions in Botswana, Mozambique and Zambia and elsewhere in Sub-Saharan Africa, as well as at the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention. The Public Health Agency of Sweden will implement the program. It will strengthen of institutional frameworks, technical capacities and human resources through cooperation with ministries of health, national agencies, academia, and civil society organizations in Africa and Sweden.

Ett kapacitetsutvecklingsprogram för att stärka sexuell och reproduktiv hälsa och rättigheter (SRHR) i nationella folkhälsoinstitutioner i Botswana, Moçambique och Zambia samt övrig Afrika söder om Sahara samt i Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Folkhälsomyndigheten kommer att genomföra programmet. Det kommer att stärka institutionella ramar, teknisk kapacitet och mänskliga resurser genom samarbete med hälsoministerier, nationella myndigheter, akademin och civilsamhällets organisationer i Afrika och Sverige.
